storage: UTF-8 JSON; numerical values native; machine-readable fields use stable latin IDs

special_sp375_rules.json.scope: SP375 special rules, not SP20 general formula

lookup_encoding.external: dataset=reference and table or graph of appendix В

math_execution.no_eval: Do not evaluate free-form text; use a parsed, whitelisted AST in the future program.
math_execution.preconditions: When formula mathematically impossible, block that computation with diagnostic; nonnormative input: show warning but allow calculable result.
math_execution.approximations: Use normative_status=ENGINEERING_APPROXIMATION and preserve provenance; ξ from formula 11.1.xi_davenport_approx; requires numerical δ and Tg1.

calculational_project_rules.xlsx: separate live Excel formulas using raw input and raw normative tables, no cached results from Go
calculational_project_rules.user_override: store normative value + manual override + provenance separately
calculational_project_rules.do_not_modify_saved_blocks: changing terrain/lookup databases must not alter already saved calculation snapshots without explicit recalculation

source: СП 20.13330.2016 изм. 1–6; раздел 11, приложение В, приложение М, п.12.3; дополнительно СП375.1325800.2023 и историческое руководство ЦНИИСК 1978 (контекст)

symbol_namespace.machine_id: unique globally; no ambiguous ID f
symbol_namespace.source_symbol: allowed to repeat by separate scope
